test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

Rima said that if she had wings, she would fly in the sky.

options.text: Rima said, "If I had wings, I would fly in the sky."
Rima said, "If I had wings, I will fly in the sky."
Rima said, "If I have wings, I would fly in the sky."
Rima said, "If I have wings, I will flew in the sky."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Rima said that if she had wings, she would fly in the sky.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"she had wings" becomes "I had wings"**
 
 
• Pronoun "she" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"she would fly" becomes "I would fly"**
 
 
• Pronoun "she" is changed to "I" for direct speech consistency.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "If" and ends with a period ".".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rima said, “If I had wings, I would fly in the sky.”"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "Rima said, “If I had wings, I will fly in the sky.”"

 
 
• Incorrect verb usage: "will" should be "would" for conditional sentences.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Rima said, “If I have wings, I would fly in the sky.”"
 
 
• Incorrect verb tense: "have" should be "had" for hypothetical situations.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Rima said, “If I have wings, I will flew in the sky.”"
 
 
• Incorrect verb tense and word usage: "will flew" is grammatically incorrect.
